Enterprises hand Cohere their most sensitive data and put our models inside workflows they can't afford to get wrong. At the heart of our mission is an unwavering commitment to safety. Behavior Verification answers one question: is the driver's on-road behavior good enough to release, and how can we prove it even further? We are seeking a rigorous and decisive systems engineer to build the evidence behind that answer. You will define the scenario and test set content that various Software releases are measured against and that enable the development of new capabilities and features, establish the validity checks that keep those test sets trustworthy, and act as the gatekeeper for what enters the release pipeline. Your work directly informs whether autonomy software is promoted.
 
You will…
Design and document the scenario and test sets that establish on-road behavior performance, from minimum to comprehensive.
Own what enters the release pipeline: define and run the scenario validity checks, and approve or refuse test sets before they are used to judge a release.
Maintain continuous quality feedback of the artifacts test sets depend on — scenarios, taggers, graders and the taxonomy behind them.
Turn behavior requirements into testable criteria, working with Behavior Requirements on targets and acceptance criteria that someone will sign.
Investigate behavior deficiencies: find further instances, establish what exposure we have to them, and return them to the pipeline as test escapes.
Distinguish genuine behavior failures from simulation artifacts, and raise simulation fidelity gaps with the corresponding teams.
Work across the organization — motion planning, simulation, evaluation, operations, safety methodology and platform — and hold the interfaces between them.
Align verification phases and cadence with the organization: what runs on a daily release, and what a significant step in exposure requires.
 
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in a relevant engineering or related field (e.g., Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, Advanced Controls, Aerospace, etc.).
Experience verifying safety-critical systems, ideallyin autonomous vehicles.
Demonstrated experience designing test cases from requirements, and assessing what a test set covers and what it misses.
Applied statistics: sample size, confidence, and what a result does and does not support.
Proficiency in Python and the ability to navigate a large codebase.
Familiarity with autonomous vehicle requirements, behaviors and design methodologies.
Strong ability to structure, document and prioritize a large number of test sets and test strategies.
Ability to work cross-functionally in a diplomatic way, across teams that do not always agree.
A drive for commitment and accountability, for yourself and for others.
 
Bonus/nice to have:
Trucking or heavy-vehicle exposure.
Machine learning experience, particularly model evaluation and false-positive / false-negative trade-offs.
Exposure to regulatory frameworks: NHTSA, ISO 26262, SOTIF.
Familiarity with the tooling required to extract coverage and exposure from large driving-log sets.
Comfortable working in a newly formed team, where the process has to be built rather than followed.

ABOUT FLOAT

Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth.

 

As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/rob-magazine/top-growing-companies/article-ranking-canadas-top-growing-companies-of-2024/ and top-rated startups in 2025 https://www.linkedin.com/posts/floatfinancial_were-proud-to-share-that-float-has-been-activity-7387093684720300032-2DDz/, 2024 https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-top-startups-2024-15-canadian-companies-rise-linkedin-news-llihe/ and 2023 https://lnkd.in/TSU23CA, Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.

 


OUR PRODUCT

Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 10,000 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C https://floatfinancial.com/press/float-financial-raises-cad-85-million-series-c, and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.




ABOUT THE TEAM

Float is building a category defining Canadian fintech at the scale of the country's biggest banks. We operate on a consumption based revenue model, Cards TPV, not seats or contracts, which means our GTM teams win by driving real product usage, every month, compounding. We're in a defining competitive window, and we move with urgency, ownership, and an aggressive bias toward rebuilding how we work with AI.

About the Role
Float is hiring a dedicated Revenue Enablement Manager to own enablement for every customer facing team: BDRs, AEs, the Customer Activation team, and Customer Success. This is a senior individual contributor role, no direct reports, full ownership of the function. You'll report to the Head of GTM Strategy & Operations and work in close partnership with Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, and Product leadership.

You'll own the full loop: building content and learning pathways, embedding our SPICED sales methodology into how reps actually sell, standing up scorecards and reinforcement mechanisms (e.g., in Gong and with front line managers), and measuring the impact of these efforts. You'll also lead messaging and readiness for major product launches (partnering with PMM/Product for inputs), and skill building initiatives like discovery call quality, competitive positioning, and QBRs. 

Within your first 60 days, you'll also lead an evaluation of our LMS and make a recommendation on whether to keep, replace, or restructure it. This is your platform to build on, so you own the call.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Enablement strategy and programs across BDR, AE, CAM, and CS: content, onboarding, learning pathways, and ongoing skill development

 - Methodology reinforcement: embedding SPICED (and evaluating where frameworks like MEDDPICC or Challenger add value) into real rep behaviour, not just a deck

 - Measurement and reinforcement infrastructure: scorecards, call scoring rubrics (e.g., in Gong or using other AI-forward tools), and a clear read on whether enablement is changing outcomes

 - Product launch and messaging enablement: partnering with Product, Product Marketing, and Sales/CS leadership to prep customer facing teams ahead of key launches

 - Tooling: operate day-to-day across Gong, Salesforce, Unify, Notion, and HubSpot; lead a first 60 days evaluation of our LMS

 - Change management: driving adoption of new programs, tools, and skills across teams that are being asked to move fast


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years owning or leading Sales/Revenue Enablement programs at a SaaS company; FinTech or consumption based revenue model experience is a bonus

 - Proven experience building and overseeing adult learning programs end-to-end, both the instructional design and the reinforcement/measurement of impact. This is a hard requirement: we're looking for someone who's done both halves, not just built content.

 - Working knowledge of a modern sales methodology (SPICED, MEDDPICC, or Challenger); we run SPICED today

 - Comfort operating in Gong and Salesforce day to day; LMS platform experience (WorkRamp or equivalent)

 - Prior quota carrying sales experience is a plus, not a requirement. That said, you'll need to earn credibility with a sales floor that moves fast and expects direct, practical coaching

 - A track record of using AI to create leverage in your own function: drafting content faster, mining call data for patterns, surfacing the highest priority gaps, not just adopting a tool because it exists


HOW WE WORK

Float operates with high urgency and high ownership. You'll be expected to move fast, say the direct thing early, and treat AI as core to how you build and scale your own function. This role exists because enablement work at Float needs someone who can own it, not administer it.



ABOUT YOU

Here's what sets you up for success at Float:

 - You Put Customers First, Always. You care deeply about delivering meaningful value. Whether you're building internal systems or customer-facing features, you're always thinking about how to make life better for our users.

 - You Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, step up to challenges, and seek solutions proactively, doing what's best for the business, not just your role.

 - You Think Big and Move Fast. You're energised by building from 0 to 1. You're not afraid to challenge the status quo, experiment quickly, and learn as you go.

 - You Constantly Learn and Grow. You're hungry to improve your craft and open to feedback. You bring a growth mindset to everything you do.

 - You Raise the Bar. You care about doing things well and efficiently. You balance speed with rigour and always look for ways to improve how we work.

 - You Win as a Team. You're a generous collaborator who values communication, context, and shared wins. You lift others up and help make the team stronger.


WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN

 - Work at one of Canada's fastest-growing fintech companies

 - Make a real impact in a high-autonomy, high-growth role

 - Collaborate with an ambitious and supportive team

 - Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits

 - Hybrid work model – we are based in Toronto with in-office days for connection and collaboration

 - Enjoy catered team lunches every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday

 - Bring your pup to our dog-friendly office

 - Thrive in a high-trust, high-performance culture where your work truly matters

 


IN SHORT

At Float, you’ll thrive if you’re bold, curious, and eager to make a real impact. We're building something special and having a lot of fun along the way. If you’re excited to build, grow, and win together, we’d love to meet you.

 

We’re committed to building a workplace that’s welcoming and accessible for everyone. If you need any accommodations during the hiring process or once you join Float, just let us know! You can reach out to Vic https://www.linkedin.com/in/victoria-boult-b21b2053/ (victoria@floatfinancial.com), and we’ll work with you to make sure you have what you need to succeed.




AI USE IN OUR HIRING PROCESS

We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by humans.

About Us 
 HarZa Group builds and scales direct-to-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our flagship brand, Rejuvacare, serves over 400,000 customers who trust us with their health and their money, and our newer brands extend that same promise into oral care and at-home light therapy. We ship primarily to the United States, run on paid digital channels, and have scaled 12x in a single year to nearly 150 people across 15+ countries. We are remote-first, async-first, and hold a high standard of accountability across everything we do.
 The Role 
 We are looking for a licensed dermatologist to become the medical voice of our brand: on camera, on the page, and behind the science.
 Our category is claims-led. The outcome we sell (healthier gum tissue, less visible recession, better skin quality) is not visually obvious in a three second scroll, and our customer is typically 50 to 70 years old and has already been disappointed by products that promised results. We do not win by showing a pretty product. We win by explaining a mechanism clearly enough that a skeptical person believes it, and by having a credible clinician stand behind that explanation.
 That is what this role is. You are not a passive endorser whose headshot sits in a footer. You explain the science on camera, you pressure-test what our copywriters write before it goes live, and your name and credentials travel with the brand.
 What You Will Do 
 Serve as the on-camera medical voice across paid social, advertorials, landing pages, email, and organic content
 Explain the mechanism behind our products (collagen biology, photobiomodulation, tissue quality with age) in language a non-technical 55+ customer actually understands
 Film short-form video content on a regular monthly cadence: mechanism explainers, myth-busting, objection handling, and Q&A formats
 Review creative, scripts, and landing page copy for medical accuracy before launch, working directly with the performance creative and copy teams
 Flag claims that overreach and propose accurate alternatives that still land commercially, rather than simply rejecting them
 Interpret existing research and help the team understand what we can and cannot say
 Be publicly named and credited as the brand's medical authority, including bio, headshot, and credentials on site
 Contribute clinical perspective to product development and positioning as the portfolio expands
 What We Are Looking For 
 Board-certified dermatologist (MD or DO) with an active, verifiable license
 Working familiarity with photobiomodulation, red and infrared light therapy, collagen biology, and age-related tissue change
 Genuinely comfortable and compelling on camera, with clear, warm, spoken English
 Willing to be publicly and permanently associated with a consumer brand, including in paid advertising
 Solid understanding of the line between structure and function claims and disease claims, and of FTC endorsement and disclosure requirements
 Able to work collaboratively with marketers: you understand that persuasion and accuracy are not enemies, and you can hold both
 Available for occasional live sessions within our collaboration window of 8am to 12pm EST
 Nice to Have 
 Prior experience as a medical advisor, scientific advisor, or brand ambassador for a consumer health brand
 An existing audience on social, YouTube, or podcast
 Publication or teaching record in dermatology, aesthetics, or light-based therapy
 Familiarity with direct response advertising and how DTC health brands operate
 Engagement and Compensation 
 This is an independent contractor engagement with a monthly retainer plus a content production component. Final structure is aligned individually based on credentials, audience, and scope of usage rights. Payments are processed via Wise on our side, and you can receive them in any USD account or wallet you use, including Payoneer, PayPal, or a USD bank account. As an independent contractor, you are responsible for your own taxes and local compliance.
 What We Offer 
 A fast-moving, remote-first environment where your input reaches millions of impressions rather than sitting in a deck. Direct access to founders and to the creative team building the work. A portfolio of brands in active expansion, which means the scope of this partnership grows as we grow. And a genuine commitment to getting the science right, because our customer base is one that cannot afford to be misled

 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 
 About this role: 
 As a Staff Product Designer at Samsara, you will set a vision and ship work that shapes the way our customers and internal teams operate. You will partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders, set the interaction patterns and visual systems other designers build on, and build direct relationships with our most strategic customers.
 This is a remote role open to candidates residing in Canada.
 You should apply if: 
 You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact: helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
 You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
 You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
 You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.
 In this role, you will: 
 Lead large, ambiguous initiatives that span multiple product areas, from problem framing through launch and iteration.
 Be a taste maker and demonstrate good judgement in your domain.
 Regularly meet and engage with our most strategic customers to bring the customer voice alongside product data into product decisions.
 Leverage AI tools through every step of the process, defining new ways of working and democratizing design at Samsara.
 Stay well informed on the emerging trends, tools, and technology. Give back to the community.
 Ship code to production across our design system, web products, and mobile apps.
 Set the bar for what great looks like through building and shipping.
 Minimum requirements for the role: 
 10+ years of product design experience designing UX/UI for web and mobile applications, with a track record of leading work that spans multiple product areas.
 A strong portfolio and/or case studies showing design craft and quantified impact at the level of multiple product areas or platform-wide systems, not just a single feature. We cannot consider applications without a portfolio at this time.
 Deep interaction and visual design skills, with the judgment to define new patterns other designers and teams build on.
 AI tools in your regular design practice (e.g., Cursor, Figma Make), with shipped work you can attribute to them.
 Experience mentoring designers formally and informally.
 Experience partnering with senior leadership.
 The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed. 
 The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below. 
 Annual Base Salary
 $161,600 — $222,200 CAD 
 Total Rewards 
 At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
 Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
 Flexible Working 
 At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 
 Belonging at Samsara 
 At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
 Accommodations 
 Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
 Our Commitment to Authenticity 
 We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

 We are excited to have a Learning Commons Facilitator opportunity available approximately December 1, 2026.
 Lethbridge School Division is looking for an energetic, collaborative and creative individual to work as part of a dynamic team. Lethbridge School Division, embraces diversity and functions in a dynamic, innovative and fast paced environment. The Learning Commons Facilitator supports schools by being an agile and responsive individual who creates an environment that is available to individuals and groups to use for multiple, often simultaneous, purposes. Learning Commons Facilitators support literacy, numeracy, competency development, and student learning outcomes. Learning Commons Facilitators provide access to print and digital resources, including the use of technology for learning in order to enable creation, collaboration, and communication. 
 Our Division is a proud neighbor to the largest First Nation reserve area in Canada which is called Kainai Nation. We are fortunate to learn from Indigenous communities and are committed to enhancing our understanding of the truths of our past so we can continue to move towards reconciliation.
 The successful applicant will act in an advisory role to assist students and staff in locating material and using technology and other learning commons resources. External contacts may be made with other learning commons or resource centers to locate requested information or materials. Learning Commons Facilitators work collaboratively in the selection and acquisition of material for the learning commons in consultation with Administration and/or the school based Learning Commons Committee. Learning Commons Facilitators provide support, space and resources for inquiry, play, and imagination.
 Learning Commons Facilitators promote and facilitate the use of quality learning resources in multiple formats and provide exposure to a wide variety of Canadian and international resources (fiction and nonfiction) which reflect multiple perspectives, promote literacy and numeracy, and develop students’ interests and competencies beyond the school setting. 
 Refer to the Learning Commons Facilitator job description for specific details. 
 What will you work? 
27.50 hours/week Monday to Friday 
 This position follows the assigned Learning Commons Facilitator calendar and affords the successful candidate to have some school breaks off.
 What do you need to succeed? 
 Have a strong understanding and commitment towards our school’s philosophy.
 Have a proven history of positive interactions with students and parents.
 Have a proven history of advocacy for community involvement in the school.
 Have a proven history of being a committed team member at both the school and division level.
 Have a proven understanding of literature that best interests students.
 Have a proven commitment to organizing, implementing and facilitating Maker Spaces. 
 We are looking for experience in the following programs: 
 Follett/Destiny
 Word
 Excel
 Publisher
 **Candidates may be tested for computer proficiency 
 Galbraith Elementary School serves approximately 275 students from EEP to Grade 5. Empowering learners to succeed as caring, responsible and contributing global citizens. Galbraith is an inclusive learning community that develops engaged, ethical and innovative learners.

 Post-secondary Diploma and related experience.

 Combination of education and experience.

 Post-secondary diploma in Library and Information Technician with some related experience.

 Lifestyle and specialty counselling (Health, Life Balance and Career).

At Tecsys, the software we deliver keeps hospitals, pharmacies and distributors supplied with what they need, when they need it. Every role here connects to that outcome. 
 Why This Role Matters    
 We're looking for a  Data Platform Engineer (DevOps)  to join our TecsysIQ Data & AI team. This is a hybrid role that builds and operates the cloud data platform powering our analytics and AI products on Databricks and AWS.
 You will own the infrastructure-as-code and delivery pipelines that provision and deploy the platform,  and  the Databricks jobs and streaming pipelines that move and shape data through it. You'll partner closely with Data Platform Developers, application dev teams, and Product Owners — standing up new customer environments, evolving the CI/CD and release process, and creating and maintaining the data pipelines that keep the platform running reliably at scale. If you are equally comfortable writing Terraform and debugging a Spark Structured Streaming job, this role is for you.
 What You’ll Be Part Of    
 Tecsys is trusted by mission-critical organizations in healthcare and distribution to power resilient, efficient and secure supply chains. We are a global provider of cloud-based, AI-driven software, publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: TCS).   
 Three values guide how we work. We earn trust daily by valuing the customer and acting with integrity. We build each other up by recognizing individual strengths and working as one team. And we explore boldly by staying curious and adapting for success.   
 You’ll join a culture driven by curiosity, continuous learning, and people who challenge what’s possible.   
 What You’ll Do    
 Platform & DevOps
 Provision and evolve AWS and Databricks accounts and workspaces using  Terraform  across multiple regions and environments, managing remote state and per-environment configuration.
 Own the  Helm charts and Kubernetes Jobs  that onboard new customer environments and deploy the application layer onto provisioned workspaces.
 Build and maintain  Docker  images and the Java/Maven build pipeline, publishing artifacts to internal artifact and container registries.
 Integrate build, test, and deployment into  CI/CD pipelines , and improve release management and versioning across interdependent repositories.
 Manage secrets and credentials safely through cloud secret management and Kubernetes — never in source control.
 Data Platform & Pipelines
 Design, build, and maintain  Databricks jobs and pipelines  — including data curation, transformation, and initial bulk-load workflows.
 Develop and operate  real-time streaming and change data capture (CDC) pipelines  across the ingestion and transformation layers using  Spark Structured Streaming .
 Build and evolve end-to-end data movement across the  Bronze, Silver, and Gold  data layers, extending pipelines to handle new sources and schema changes as the platform grows.
 Develop and maintain reusable pipeline components and frameworks so new data workflows can be onboarded and shipped quickly.
 Tune clusters and SQL warehouses for cost and performance, and manage catalog, schema, and access governance across environments.
 Collaborate with Data Platform Developers, Product Owners, and business stakeholders in an Agile environment to deliver high-quality data products.
 What You Bring    
 Hands-on experience with  Databricks  and  Apache Spark , including building batch or streaming data pipelines (mandatory).
 Strong  Terraform  skills and comfort managing cloud infrastructure on  AWS .
 Working knowledge of  Kubernetes  and  Helm , and containerization with  Docker .
 Proficiency in  Python  (PySpark) and/or  Java , plus strong SQL for data validation and troubleshooting.
 Experience with Git-based workflows and  CI/CD pipelines  in a multi-repository codebase.
 Understanding of data quality, ETL/ELT, and data observability concepts.
 Experience working in Agile teams alongside Data Platform Developers and Product Owners.
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
 Fluency in written and spoken English is essential for communicating effectively with clients, suppliers, business partners, and colleagues outside of Quebec.  
 Benefits   
 Why You’ll Love It Here   
 Remote-first flexibility and the trust to manage your own time   
 Benefits and vacation from day one   
 Pension plan with competitive employer contribution   
 Employee events and community initiatives   
 Room to learn, stretch and take on new challenges   
 Collaboration with global teams   
 We foster an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive.   
  If this role fits what you are looking for, apply today. If you are not actively searching but want to hear more, we are glad to talk    
 Apply today and discover what you could build, solve, and achieve with Tecsys!   
 #LI-TECSYS

HELLO!

I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. I’m excited to share that we’re hiring our first Support Engineering Manager in AMER.

Support Engineering is the technical bridge between frontline Support, Product, and Engineering. The team investigates complex product and customer issues, helps confirm which problems truly require code changes, and enables the broader Support organization to resolve more issues independently. We’re looking for a hands-on leader to make that bridge stronger as the function grows—aligning technical rigor with Ashby’s broader standards for customer success.

This is not a traditional Support Manager role. You’ll manage and mentor Support Engineers, stay close to complex investigations, and work with Engineering and Product to improve how technical issues are diagnosed, escalated, and resolved. You’ll help define the standards and systems that let a small, highly technical team move quickly without sacrificing judgment or quality.




ABOUT THE ROLE

When a complex issue moves beyond frontline Support, Support Engineering investigates the problem using customer context, application behavior, logs, databases, integrations, APIs, and code-level context. The team determines whether the issue can be resolved through configuration, data correction, documentation, enablement, or an in-app change—or whether it is a product defect that Engineering needs to fix. Your role is to make that path clearer and more effective: develop a deep understanding of how each partner team works, coach the investigation, and ensure escalations meet a shared standard for evidence, ownership, and customer impact.

You’ll lead the team’s day-to-day technical development while building the connective tissue around it. That includes reviewing investigations and escalations, mentoring Support Engineers through ambiguous problems, clarifying triage and handoff practices, identifying recurring patterns, and partnering with frontline Support, Product, and Engineering on durable improvements. You’ll help ensure Support Engineering scales in a way that reflects Ashby’s broader expectations for customer success—not simply by passing issues between teams, but by resolving more issues independently and making the right problems easier for Engineering to act on.

As the first Support Engineering Manager at Ashby, you’ll have meaningful influence over how the function grows. You’ll balance people leadership with hands-on technical judgment, make pragmatic decisions with incomplete information, and focus the team on the work that most improves customer outcomes, strengthens cross-functional trust, and protects Engineering time.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Lead, coach, and develop Support Engineers through regular feedback, technical mentorship, career development, and clear expectations for ownership and judgment.

 - Stay close to complex investigations by reviewing technical work, joining escalations when useful, and coaching the team on APIs, integrations, logs, databases, data issues, configuration, and product behavior.

 - Build shared operating standards across Support, Support Engineering, Product, and Engineering that help frontline Support resolve more issues independently, reduce customer effort, and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable escalations when code changes are needed.

 - Partner with Engineering and Product to synthesize recurring customer patterns, validate defects, improve supportability, and determine whether the right solution is a code change, documentation, tooling, enablement, or process improvement.

 - Identify the highest-leverage friction in the team’s workflows and ship practical improvements to tooling, diagnostics, routing, documentation, and operating processes.

 - Hire and onboard future Support Engineers, help define the team’s career path, and build a scalable model for technical growth as the function expands across regions.

 - Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, frontline self-sufficiency, customer effort, recurring issue reduction, and Engineering time spent on confirmed defects and roadmap work.


YOU SHOULD APPLY IF

 - You have direct people-management experience leading a technical support, developer support, production support, or support engineering team in a B2B SaaS or similarly complex software environment.

 - You are energized by hands-on people leadership: reviewing work, giving precise feedback, raising technical judgment, and helping strong engineers grow.

 - You have coached an Engineer through a specific technical or judgment gap and can point to what changed as a result.

 - You have enough technical depth to reason about APIs, integrations, logs, databases, application behavior, and code-level context—and to coach others through ambiguous investigations.

 - You know how to distinguish a configuration, data, documentation, or enablement issue from a true product defect, and can help a team make that decision with evidence.

 - You have improved an escalation, triage, or support-to-Engineering workflow and can explain what changed, why you changed it, and how you measured the result.

 - You build structure without over-engineering. You can make clear decisions with incomplete information, ship a useful first version, and iterate based on what you learn. You’ve stood up processes, workflows, or standards from scratch.

 - You communicate clearly and thoughtfully with technical and non-technical audiences, especially when explaining tradeoffs, uncertainty, customer impact, and recommended action.


YOU SHOULD NOT APPLY IF

 - You have not yet directly managed a team, and your leadership experience has primarily been through mentorship, project leadership, or team-lead responsibilities. This role requires direct people-management experience, including accountability for team development, feedback, and day-to-day management.

 - You’re looking primarily for a traditional queue-management or people-management role where you can stay removed from technical investigations and escalation quality.

 - Most of your experience is in internal IT, help desk, endpoint, infrastructure, cloud operations, or systems administration without substantial experience debugging customer-impacting SaaS applications and integrations.

 - You prefer to optimize processes from a distance rather than work directly with engineers on the details of diagnosis, evidence, and technical judgment.

 - You see Support Engineering primarily as a pass-through queue to Engineering rather than an investigation and enablement layer that should resolve more issues independently.

 - You’re uncomfortable operating in a growing function where ownership boundaries, workflows, and success measures will continue to evolve.

 - You prefer prolonged analysis or perfect certainty over making a well-reasoned decision, learning quickly, and improving the system in motion.

Ashby builds a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better.
